bio.summary: Sasquatch, Trail Steward is a fictional sasquatch (trail staff) standup performer. Eight-foot Pacific Northwest steward. Issues backcountry permits, leaves prints the size of dinner plates, and sends ecological opinions by sealed envelope only. The act circles the trail cam and the documentary crew. Onstage the register is gentle.
